tools.name: calculate_emissions_transaction
tools.description: Calculate CO2e emissions for a business transaction (spend-based)

tools.name: calculate_emissions_flight
tools.description: Calculate CO2e emissions for a flight

tools.name: calculate_emissions_freight
tools.description: Calculate CO2e emissions for freight transport (sea, road, rail, or air cargo). Supports single-leg and multi-leg intermodal journeys. Locations accept UN/LOCODE (e.g. 'GBSOU'), IATA airport code (e.g. 'LHR'), free-text name (e.g. 'Southampton'), or lat/lon coordinates. For multi-leg journeys provid

tools.name: calculate_emissions_activity
tools.description: Calculate CO2e emissions for an activity (electricity, fuel combustion, materials, transport, etc.)

tools.name: calculate_emissions_activity_batch
tools.description: Calculate CO2e emissions for up to 100 activities in a single request. Each item is resolved in parallel. Items that fail validation or are not found return per-item errors without failing the whole batch.

tools.name: calculate_cbam_liability
tools.description: Calculate CBAM (Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism) embedded emissions and estimated EUR liability for an imported good. Covers Phase 1 sectors: cement, aluminium, iron & steel, fertilisers, hydrogen. Applies the year's phase-in rate (2.5% in 2026, ramping to 100% by 2032) and uses the live EU ETS p

tools.name: calculate_cbam_batch
tools.description: Calculate CBAM liability for up to 100 shipments in one request and return a portfolio-level summary (total embedded tCO2e, total certificates, total EUR liability). Ideal for pricing a whole shipment manifest or product catalogue. Per-item ok/not_covered/error — one bad item doesn't fail the batch.

tools.name: lookup_cbam_cn_codes
tools.description: Look up / search EU Combined Nomenclature (CN) codes for CBAM. Find the 8-digit code for a product, check whether it is currently subject to CBAM (cbam_phase1=true) and which sector, then pass the cn_code to calculate_cbam_liability.

tools.name: lookup_cbam_carbon_prices
tools.description: Look up the carbon price(s) in a country (World Bank Carbon Pricing Dashboard) as an INDICATIVE starting figure for the carbon_price_paid_eur_per_tonne input on calculate_cbam_liability. tools.name: lookup_emission_factors
tools.description: Look up emission factors by classification code (MCC, NAICS, ISIC, SIC, NACE, BEA) or activity type

tools.name: list_activity_types
tools.description: List available activity types for emission calculations, optionally filtered by country or category
